rewind.noticeSaveFailed: Rewound: {count} file(s) reverted, but failed to save state: {error}

fork.unavailableNoResponse: Cannot fork: no response to fork from
fork.commandNoMessages: Cannot fork: no messages in conversation
fork.commandNoAssistantUuid: Cannot fork: no assistant response with identifiers

externalContext.duplicate: This folder is already added as external context.
externalContext.conflictInside: Cannot add "{newPath}" because it is inside existing path "{existingPath}".
externalContext.conflictContains: Cannot add "{newPath}" because it contains existing path "{existingPath}".
externalContext.title: External contexts
externalContext.empty: Click the folder icon to add one.
externalContext.countTitle: {count} external contexts. Click to add more.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.countTitle: {count} MCP servers enabled. Click to manage.

userName.name: What should Codex for Obsidian call you?
userName.desc: Your name for personalized greetings (leave empty for generic greetings)

excludedTags.name: Excluded tags
excludedTags.desc: Notes with these tags will not auto-load as context (one per line, without #)

mediaFolder.name: Media folder
mediaFolder.desc: Folder containing attachments/images. When notes use ![[image.jpg]], Codex will look here. Leave empty for vault root.

systemPrompt.name: Custom system prompt
systemPrompt.desc: Additional instructions appended to the default system prompt

autoTitle.name: Auto-generate conversation titles
autoTitle.desc: Automatically generate conversation titles after the first user message is sent.

titleModel.name: Title generation model
titleModel.desc: Model used for auto-generating conversation titles.

navMappings.name: Vim-style navigation mappings
navMappings.desc: One mapping per line. Format: "map <key> <action>" (actions: scrollUp, scrollDown, focusInput).

slashCommands.name: Commands and Skills
slashCommands.desc: Manage vault-level commands and skills stored in .claude/commands/ and .claude/skills/. Triggered by /name.

hiddenSlashCommands.name: Hidden Commands
hiddenSlashCommands.desc: Hide specific slash commands from the dropdown. Useful for hiding Codex commands that are not relevant to Codex for Obsidian. Enter command names without the leading slash, one per line.

mcpServers.name: MCP Servers
mcpServers.desc: Manage vault-level MCP server configurations stored in .claude/mcp.json. Servers with context-saving mode require @mention to activate.

plugins.name: Codex Plugins
plugins.desc: Manage Codex plugins discovered from ~/.claude/plugins. Enabled plugins are stored per vault in .claude/settings.json.

subagents.name: Subagents
subagents.desc: Manage vault-level subagents stored in .claude/agents/. Each Markdown file defines one custom agent.
subagents.noAgents: No subagents configured. Click + to create one.
subagents.renameCleanupFailed: Warning: could not remove old file for "{name}"

modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews code for bugs and style
modal.toolsDesc: Comma-separated list of allowed tools (empty = all)
modal.disallowedToolsDesc: Comma-separated list of tools to disallow
modal.promptPlaceholder: You are a code reviewer. Analyze the given code for...

loadUserSettings.name: Load user Codex settings
loadUserSettings.desc: Load ~/.claude/settings.json. When enabled, user's Codex permission rules may bypass Safe mode.

claudeSafeMode.name: Safe mode
claudeSafeMode.desc: Permission mode used when the Safe toggle is active.

codexSafeMode.name: Safe mode
codexSafeMode.desc: Sandbox mode used when the Safe toggle is active.

customVariables.name: Custom variables
customVariables.desc: Environment variables for Codex SDK (KEY=VALUE format, one per line). Shell export prefix supported.

envSnippets.name: Snippets
envSnippets.noSnippets: No saved environment snippets yet. Click + to save your current environment configuration.
envSnippets.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the snippet

modal.name: Name
modal.namePlaceholder: A descriptive name for this environment configuration
modal.envVarsPlaceholder: KEY=VALUE format, one per line (export prefix supported)

customContextLimits.name: Custom Context Limits
customContextLimits.desc: Set context window sizes for your custom models. Leave empty to use the default (200k tokens).
customContextLimits.invalid: Invalid format. Use: 256k, 1m, or exact count (1000-10000000).

enableOpus1M.name: GPT-5.4 context window
enableOpus1M.desc: Show GPT-5.4 in the model selector. Included with Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

enableSonnet1M.name: GPT-5.4 Mini context window
enableSonnet1M.desc: Show GPT-5.4 Mini in the model selector. Requires extra usage on Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

enableChrome.name: Enable Chrome extension
enableChrome.desc: Allow Codex to interact with Chrome via the claude-in-chrome extension. Requires the extension to be installed. Requires session restart.

enableBangBash.name: Enable bash mode (!)
enableBangBash.desc: Type ! on empty input to enter bash mode. Runs commands directly via Node.js child_process. Requires view reopen.

validation.noNode: Node.js not found on PATH. Install Node.js or check your PATH configuration.

maxTabs.name: Maximum chat tabs
maxTabs.desc: Maximum number of concurrent chat tabs (3-10). Each tab uses a separate Codex session.
maxTabs.warning: More than 5 tabs may impact performance and memory usage.

tabBarPosition.name: Tab bar position
tabBarPosition.desc: Choose where to display tab badges and action buttons

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Codex streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

openInMainTab.name: Open in main editor area
openInMainTab.desc: Open chat panel as a main tab in the center editor area instead of the right sidebar

cliPath.name: Codex CLI path
cliPath.desc: Custom path to Codex CLI. Leave empty for auto-detection.
cliPath.descWindows: For the native installer, use claude.exe. For npm/pnpm/yarn or other package manager installs, use the cli.js path (not claude.cmd).
cliPath.descUnix: Paste the output of "which claude" — works for both native and npm/pnpm/yarn installs.

validation.isDirectory: Path is a directory, not a file

language.name: Language
language.desc: Change the display language of the plugin interface

advancedSection.title: Advanced settings
advancedSection.singlePageDesc: Low-frequency options live here. Keep the defaults unless you need WSL, environment variables, keyboard navigation, or custom context limits.
advancedSection.generalDesc: Interface behavior, keyboard navigation, shortcuts, and context-limit options. The defaults are fine for first use.
advancedSection.codexDesc: WSL, Codex-specific environment variables, and custom context limits. Keep the defaults unless you need them.

permission.tooltipConfirm: Ask before sensitive commands or file changes.
permission.tooltipAuto: Let Codex run commands and edit files with minimal prompts.
permission.tooltipPlan: Plan first without directly changing files.

apiKey.name: OpenAI API key
apiKey.desc: Optional. Usually unnecessary when the Codex CLI is already signed in. Use this only when you want the plugin to provide a specific key.

installationMethod.name: Installation method
installationMethod.desc: Windows only. Native Windows launches the Windows executable; WSL launches Codex inside the selected Linux distribution.

cliPath.name: Codex CLI path ({hostname})
cliPath.desc: Local Codex CLI path. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH; fill this only if detection fails.
cliPath.descNative: Custom path to the local Codex CLI. Leave empty for PATH auto-detection. On Windows this is usually codex.exe.
cliPath.descWsl: Linux-side Codex command or absolute path to run inside WSL. Leave empty to look it up from PATH inside the selected distribution.

validation.wslWindowsPath: WSL mode expects a Linux command or Linux absolute path, not a Windows executable path.

wslDistro.name: WSL distro override
wslDistro.desc: WSL only. Leave empty to infer the distro from a \\wsl$ workspace path when possible, otherwise use the default WSL distro.

safeMode.name: File access scope
safeMode.desc: File access used in Ask first mode. Workspace write can edit the current vault; read-only cannot write files.

reasoningSummary.name: Reasoning summary
reasoningSummary.desc: Controls whether the thinking block shows a summary of the model reasoning. Turn it off for a cleaner interface.

environment.name: Codex environment
environment.desc: Codex-specific runtime variables. Advanced users can set OPENAI_*, CODEX_*, proxies, certificates, or a custom base URL here.
